newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lankan rupee ends weaker after ranged trade.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lankan rupee ends weaker after ranged trade.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed weaker against the dollar on Wednesday on the U.S. unit's overseas strength, dealers said.
"Dollar trading remained ranged with little or no commercial demand to push it out of the groove," said a foreign bank dealer.
The rupee closed at 55.80 to the dollar after opening at 55.77, they said. The rupee closed at 55.75 on Tuesday.
Overnight call money closed at 15 percent after opening at 17, dealers said.
Although money market rates eased allowing banks to build up dollar positions, they held back ahead of the final quarter when money rates are usually volatile, dealers said.
The Central Bank pushed up the dollar by 4.25 local cents, and fixed buying and selling prices at 55.6108 and 56.7342 in the morning.
